entities.summary: The Babeș-Bolyai University is a public research university located in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. Established in 1581 as Academia Claudiopolitana, it underwent several reorganizations over the centuries, eventually taking its current form in 1959 through the merger of Bolyai University and Victor Babeș University. It occupies the first position in the University Metaranking, initiated by the Romanian Ministry of Education and Research in 2016.
